The Node Palette contains various nodes you can use in your workflow.

Click on Prompt, Sub-Agent, AskUserQuestion, If/Else, Switch, and other nodes to add them to the canvas.

Start and End nodes are already placed.

You can edit node name, prompt, model selection, and more.
